Three levels

How much of you do you want in the twin?

Most people start with the voice. The face and the brain come when you are ready.

Your voice

Your twin speaks in your voice. Your words, your pace, your accent. Over your own footage or a still of you.

Your face

Your twin appears on camera. Talking to camera, or teaching from a golf course. You were never there.

Your brain

Your twin writes the videos too, from what you know and how you think. You approve. It posts every day.

Why it works when others do not

The twin is one part out of ten.

Anyone can make a face talk. That is the easy part. What to say, how to cut it, where it goes, what it did, and what happens after someone watches: that is the other nine parts. We run all ten.

You are not buying a twin. You are buying the nine parts around it.

Straight answers

Questions people ask us

Is the twin really mine?

Yes. Your face, your voice, your way of thinking. It is yours. If you stop, you keep it, and nobody else can use it.

Do people know it is AI?

Some ask. Most watch. The words are yours, the knowledge is yours, and you approve every video. That is what people trust.

What do I have to do?

One recording session at the start, and one call a month. You approve videos on your phone. That is all.

How long until my twin is posting?

Weeks, not months. The voice comes first. The face and the brain follow. We tell you the date on the first call.

How much does it cost?

It depends on the size of your business. One number a month, and you hear it on the first call.

What should we call you?

"They call the clinic" or "they DM me for the price" are both useful answers.
